case.summary: Customer C02354 disputed a $39.08 in person purchase on card C02354-K2, claiming they never made the transaction. Investigation revealed that the disputed charge matched the card's own recurring pattern, appearing 19 times in the previous 119 days for the exact same amount. Shown the earlier charges in the assumed reply, the cardholder recognised the recurring merchant and withdrew the dispute. The case is classified as legitimate per policy R7.
